overlanding-life.author: Gary (guest)
overlanding-life.text: Hi, Gary and Kim here in Erzurum. Let us know if you're heading here (I can see you're not too far away) We're stuck having our 2nd go at getting an Iranian visa!! How did you go with yours? Staying at the Otel Dede as camping around here is a nightmare. E-mail youngtrippers at yahoo dot co dot uk  G

overlanding-toys.author: farmerdomnbob
overlanding-toys.text: Great post, makes me realise everything we should have taken!!! Our plans went belly up after Bob lost her job so we've rented the flat out, sold the landie and jumped in the vit. Heading to India for about october time if we can get all the visa's sorted! Need a fridge and a table but we have got a petrol cooker! We're slowly sending things home as we realise what we don't need! Chilling in Corfu replenising our funds after europe and then off to Turkey. Keep up the good work, we're both really enjoying your blog and Jenny's write up on Iran has really put Bob's mind at rest! It's nice to be important but more important to be nice.

overlanding-toys.author: paul64
overlanding-toys.text: Hi Ollie & Jenny, Any news on the zip that broke on your tent. I can't remember what make your tent is, but if it is a MyWay, I have recently heard that broken zips are a common cause for complaint. Cheers, Paul

overlanding-toys.author: jenny
overlanding-toys.text: Hi Paul & all, Yes, it is a MyWay tent and it certainly sounds like there were a couple of people with a similar problem. I received an update from the MyWay man in the UK (also a Paul) and it sounds like they have made some changes to the design to fix the problem which is great news as it's a good tent. The cover is now bigger and the zip has some protection..so all is good... As for us.. we are still velcroing the tent closed which is fine.. we haven't seen rain for a while!!!! (Sorry to all those in the rain filled uk!) Cheers, Jenny

roaming-in-romania.author: paul64
roaming-in-romania.text: Hi Ollie & Jenny, I have made some radical changes to my blog, I hope you like them! I have moved your story to my dedicated Overland Travellers page www.trackranger.com/2009/07/travellers.html Please spread the word as although we have stopped the tours we are still welcoming travellers for camping and I can advise on things to see and do. We now have running water, electricity, and inside loo and wi-fi! Laura says hi! Cheers, Paul

roaming-in-romania.author: jenny
roaming-in-romania.text: Wow...that all sounds like positive luxury!!! ;D We'll spread the word on the road ... we already rave about Romania anyway! Say hi to Laura and Mr.P for us! Cheers, Jenny
